name: 分子信号传导与级联反应预设
description: 专注于细胞内分子信号网络、激酶级联、翻译后修饰与转录调控的细粒度实体与机制分类体系。

Kinase_Phosphatase.label: 激酶 / 磷酸酶
Kinase_Phosphatase.description: 催化磷酸化或去磷酸化级联反应的关键酶蛋白
Kinase_Phosphatase.en_description: Key catalytic enzymes mediating phosphorylation or dephosphorylation cascades.

Transcription_Factor.label: 转录因子 / 核受体
Transcription_Factor.description: 特异性结合DNA并调控基因转录的因子或辅因子
Transcription_Factor.en_description: Sequence-specific DNA-binding factors and cofactors regulating gene transcription.

Receptor_Adapter.label: 受体 / 接头蛋白
Receptor_Adapter.description: 膜受体、胞质受体及传递信号的支架接头蛋白
Receptor_Adapter.en_description: Membrane receptors, cytosolic sensors, and scaffold/adapter signaling proteins.

Second_Messenger_Ion.label: 第二信使 / 离子 / 代谢分子
Second_Messenger_Ion.description: cAMP, IP3, DAG, Ca2+及信号级联中的小分子信使
Second_Messenger_Ion.en_description: Small molecules and ions (cAMP, IP3, DAG, Ca2+) propagating intracellular signals.

Effector_Target_Gene.label: 下游效应蛋白 / 靶基因
Effector_Target_Gene.description: 通路末端效应蛋白、细胞骨架组件或激活转录的靶基因
Effector_Target_Gene.en_description: Downstream effector proteins, cytoskeletal components, or transcribed target genes.

Pathway_Module.label: 通路模块 / 生理过程
Pathway_Module.description: 如MAPK通路、PI3K/AKT级联、凋亡进程或自噬流
Pathway_Module.en_description: Canonical signaling pathways (MAPK, PI3K/AKT), apoptosis cascades, or autophagy flux.

Uncertain.label: 无法判断 / 未定
Uncertain.description: 文献证据不足或上下文含糊、无法明确归类的分子实体
Uncertain.en_description: Molecular entities with ambiguous context or insufficient evidence in literature.

Phosphorylation.label: 磷酸化 / 激活修饰
Phosphorylation.en_description: Enzymatic addition of a phosphate group leading to functional activation or conformational change.

Dephosphorylation.label: 去磷酸化 / 失活
Dephosphorylation.en_description: Enzymatic removal of a phosphate group, typically causing inactivation.

Ubiquitination_Degradation.label: 泛素化 / 靶向降解
Ubiquitination_Degradation.en_description: Ubiquitin conjugation targeting substrates for proteasomal or lysosomal degradation.

Transcriptional_Activation.label: 转录激活 / 诱导表达
Transcriptional_Activation.en_description: Binding to promoter/enhancer elements to upregulate target gene expression.

Complex_Assembly.label: 复合物组装 / 招募结合
Complex_Assembly.en_description: Recruitment and physical assembly of multi-protein signaling complexes.

Translocation.label: 核转位 / 亚细胞迁移
Translocation.en_description: Subcellular trafficking, such as nuclear translocation or membrane recruitment.

Allosteric_Regulation.label: 变构调节 / 反馈回路
Allosteric_Regulation.en_description: Non-covalent binding at an allosteric site altering protein conformation and activity.

en_description: Fine-grained ontology focused on intracellular signaling networks, kinase cascades, post-translational modifications, and transcriptional regulation.
